_about: Needle's-eye screening dataset. Distances and bearings are atlas-relative teaching data, not patient-specific safety margins.

_policy.inclusion: pleura/lung, major vessels, major nerves, spinal cord/medulla, heart/trachea, kidney, orbit/eyeball, facial nerve
_policy.view: operator view from the needle handle toward the tip; axis labels are computed from the anatomical direction of each screen axis
_policy.rings: relative proximity zones; never labelled as millimetres
_policy.cross: center overlap only when the reviewed ray intersects the mesh; beyond the model depth limit it is shown as an extension crossing
_policy.track: [depthMm, xMm, yMm] — in-plane offset of the structure in the cross-section at that depth (±2 mm slab, within 35 mm)
_policy.unknown: concept structures without a model mesh remain in the list and are not assigned an invented position
